AI image validation for fraud detection

Launched an AI tool that checks submitted images for fraud, so reviewers only see the cases that need a human.

  • 85% less manual fraud review volume
  • 50% less overall review time
  • AI
  • Automation
  • Operations

The problem

The operations team reviewed images for fraud by hand. As volume grew, manual review became a bottleneck in both cost and speed.

What I did

  • Scoped the problem into an AI-based validation tool that flags suspicious images and lets clean ones through.
  • Managed the launch end to end with my team of 4, from intake and prioritization through delivery.

The outcome

  • 85% less manual fraud review volume
  • 50% less overall review time
